name: eBay
about: Biggest selection of Beat parts in the US. The parts section above pulls from here once eBay is connected.

name: PP1 Beat
where: Toronto, Canada. Ships to the US with no duties
about: A whole store just for the Beat. Mostly maintenance stuff like timing belt kits, brakes, filters and radiators, plus J-Works and Giga N1 mufflers. Free shipping over $350.

name: EtsuRyu
about: Small shop that does kei cars (Beat, Cappuccino, AZ-1). Has a PP1 section with repair kits and some rare stuff like Kamimura velocity stacks.

name: Nengun Performance
about: Big Japanese performance parts store. Has aftermarket parts and genuine Honda parts for the Beat.

name: RHDJapan
about: Japanese aftermarket parts like exhausts, suspension and aero, shipped from Japan.

name: Amayama
about: Genuine Honda parts catalog. Good for seals, trim, lights and other original parts. Honda has started remaking some Beat parts too.

name: Redline360
about: US performance parts store. They carry the CUSCO front strut bar made for the Beat.

name: Etsy
about: Stickers, decals, keychains, custom shift knobs and cat everything. You can filter by shop location.

name: Sanrio
about: Sanrio's own store. Plushies, keychains and accessories for Hello Kitty, Kuromi, My Melody and the rest. Not much made for cars, but lots for the dashboard.

name: Amazon
about: Generic cosmetic stuff that isn't Beat specific: LED bulbs, interior lights, seat covers, valve caps, tow straps.

name: Metro Restyling
about: Vinyl wrap film from 3M, Avery and others. It's where a lot of wrap shops buy their film.
